tenderSchedule.title: Operation and Maintenance of Transfer Station at Vasanth Nagar (150-200TPD)
tenderSchedule.description: Operation and Maintenance of Transfer Station at Vasanth Nagar 200TPD with 2no static compactors with container changeover mechanism, 15 no containers of 20 Cum capacity and 7 nos Hook loaders mounted on 28 T GVW chassis (BS VI Make) (O&M as per section V) The cost should include Manpower cost (drivers, helpers, operators, technicians and security guards etc.,), Maintenance of Weight Bridge, Spares, Consumables, lubricants, filters fuel, DG Set, tyres and vehicle periodic service cost etc

tenderAddress.blockNumber: office of CE CGM (Tech), BSWML,Thimmaiah Road, Vasanthnagar, Bengaluru-52

tenderEligibilityCriterionList.description: Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka

EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.
